summary: SeleneX is an interactive citizen-science platform inspired by NASA’s SPHEREx mission that transforms multi-epoch, multi-wavelength all-sky survey data into an accessible scientific discovery workflow. Built on a structured Observe → Compare → Investigate methodology, the platform enables students, researchers, and astronomy enthusiasts to compare biannual sky observations across spectral bands, detect transient or variable cosmic phenomena, and document evidence-based hypotheses. By combining an interactive temporal sky comparator (Sky Across Time), a quality-driven progression log (My Cosmic Journey), community peer review (Hypothesis Lab), and IVOA-compatible reporting tools (Research Lab), SeleneX democratizes space data analysis and turns public curiosity into reproducible astronomical research.
details:
Project Details: SeleneX (SPHEREx & Planet X Exploration)

  • What does it do and how does it work? SeleneX is an advanced interactive web platform and space exploration system designed to analyze cosmological spectral data, star maps, and galaxy distribution derived from NASA’s SPHEREx observatory mission, alongside simulating the exploration of undiscovered worlds (Planet X). It processes spectral data and transforms it into immersive 3D visualizations and interactive dashboards, allowing users to track and monitor chemical signatures of water, ice, and organic materials deep in space.
    • Educational & Scientific Support: Simplifies complex space data for students, researchers, and astronomy enthusiasts without requiring deep programming skills in raw data analysis.
    • Water & Organic Resource Discovery: Provides quick visual indicators to help identify celestial bodies harboring life-supporting elements or targeted chemical signatures.
    • Space Science Awareness: Promotes astronomy and space technology to the public through an engaging, interactive format.
    • Bridging the Gap: Translating massive datasets from NASA space missions into accessible, actionable knowledge tools.
    • Inspiring the Next Generation: Encouraging youth and students in Oman and beyond to explore space sciences, spectral analysis, and artificial intelligence applications in astronomy.
    • Programming Languages: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (for interactive user interfaces and web graphics).
    • Frameworks & Software: Advanced web visualization libraries and UI design platforms like Canva.
    • Project Management & Collaboration: Generative AI tools to accelerate code development and content structuring, alongside team collaboration and version control platforms among SeleneX team members (Saeed Al Maamari, Sarah Al Mazrouei, Ali Al Balushi, Khalfan Al Maamari, and Ibtihaj Al Esaei).
    • Gamification & Interactive Exploration: Combines education with interactive entertainment, taking users on a visual journey through space like true explorers analyzing galaxy color spectra.
    • Flexibility & Accessibility: Delivered as a lightweight, flexible web application that runs directly on any browser without heavy installations, featuring an innovative UI inspired by deep-space exploration.
    • Scientific Accuracy: Aligning with true astronomical concepts and standards based on NASA’s SPHEREx space challenges.
    • User Experience (UX/UI): Ensuring an intuitive, fast-loading, and responsive interface across various devices.
    • Teamwork & Role Distribution: Leveraging the diverse skills of the SeleneX team (design, programming, project management, and analysis) to deliver a high-quality project on time for the in-person finals in Bidiya.
